hypotheses.reasoning: At 03:10:47 notification-svc hot-reloaded config revision 796, which changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:9090. Every render call after that (from 03:12:01 on) fails with ECONNREFUSED on 10.20.236.197:9090. Before the reload, renders succeeded at 26–75ms. template-svc itself stays healthy the whole time: it keeps logging normal GC with heap around 30–40%, it shows no errors, and there was no deploy. So the new URL most likely points at a port that template-svc doesn't listen on. notification-svc then returns 503 and the gateway reports 503s for POST /v1/notify, which is the alert. Those are downstream symptoms. Redis, notif-db and notif-worker all look normal.
Another reading of ECONNREFUSED is that template-svc's listener went down. But template-svc keeps logging normally and the errors start right after the config change, so this is unlikely.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc config revision 796, restoring the previous TEMPLATE_SVC_URL with the correct port, or force a config reload. Check that /render calls succeed and that POST /v1/notify success rate recovers. Add validation or a canary check for endpoint config changes in config-service.
